preferences.title: My preferences
preferences.projectionEndAgeHelp: Used for annuity goals. Allowed value: 70 to 120.
preferences.interfaceLanguageHelp: Choose the language used for application text.
preferences.privateModeHelp: Hides figures linked to your portfolio on every page.
preferences.privateModeDetails: Market data (prices, daily changes) remains visible. Only personal amounts (total value, dividends, fees, performance) are replaced by dots.
preferences.localPeaSearchHelp: Uses the local PEA stock and ETF list to speed up search and avoid API calls.
preferences.localPeaSearchDetails: When enabled, only PEA-eligible securities are suggested. Disable it to search all stocks and ETFs.
preferences.assetNewsHelp: Shows articles linked to the ticker on an asset detail page.
preferences.assetNewsDetails: When disabled, no article block is displayed and no backend news call is made.
preferences.newsLanguagesHelp: Keep at least one language enabled for articles.
preferences.newsLanguageLocked: At least one language must remain enabled
preferences.advancedModeHelp: Expands the detail blocks of the asset page by default.
preferences.advancedModeDetails: When off, asset pages stay short: full ratios, charts and history open with one click. A block you open or close yourself keeps your choice in this browser.

importGuide.title: Boursorama import guide

preview.title: Preview
preview.text: The files are read: nothing is written yet.

decide.title: Your choices
decide.text: Tick, correct or pick the matching position.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.text: Only the selected lines are written, recomputed on the current state.

preview.label: Preview
preview.text: Read only: you see what will happen before anything is written.

write.label: Adds
write.text: Creates or completes positions, trades or movements, after you confirm.

verify.label: Verifies
verify.text: "Verified by cash statement" badge: the operation is found to the cent on the statement.

certify.label: Certifies
certify.text: "Certified by statement" badge: the dividend is confirmed by the coupon statement.

flag.label: Flags
flag.text: Duplicate, missing document or inconsistency: nothing is written without your consent.

overview.title: How imports work
overview.intro: Four Boursorama documents feed your PEA. Each has a precise role: the first ones add your operations, the next ones check them. Import them in order when possible: each import relies on the previous ones.
overview.tip: PDFs are read in memory then forgotten: only the useful data (dates, amounts, quantities, ISIN) is kept, never your name or IBAN.

csv.title: CSV positions import
csv.intro: The CSV is a snapshot of your portfolio at a given time: one line per security, with quantity and cost price. Use it to get started quickly or to resynchronise positions.
csv.document: CSV export of the PEA positions.
csv.prerequisite: None: it is a possible starting point.

points.preview: The preview shows the detected asset for each line; fix the ticker, quantity or cost price flagged in red.
points.import: "Import CSV" adds the positions with their quantity and cost price.
points.update: "Update via CSV" compares the app with the file: merge, replace or ignore each line.
points.missing: A position missing from the CSV is deleted only after explicit confirmation.

csv.tip: The CSV has no dated purchase history. For complete tracking (dates, fees, ISIN), prefer trade confirmations.

avis.title: Trade confirmations (PDF)
avis.intro: A trade confirmation is sent after each executed order. It gives the date and time, side, quantity, price, fees and ISIN: the most accurate source for your buys and sells.
avis.document: One PDF per order, several files at once.
avis.prerequisite: None. With the cash account set up, available funds are checked.

points.preview: Each notice is extracted then shown for review: date, asset, side, quantity, price and fees can be edited.
points.create: Ticked lines become buys or sells, with the order reference and ISIN.
points.link: An identical trade already entered by hand receives the notice reference and ISIN, without a duplicate.
points.duplicates: An already imported notice or a likely duplicate is offered unticked; ticking it creates a second trade.
points.funds: If cash is insufficient, a dialog offers to record the deposit that funded the purchase.

avis.tip: Re-importing the same notice creates nothing: its order reference is recognised.

coupons.title: Coupon statements (PDF)
coupons.intro: The monthly coupon statement lists the dividends received: gross, withholding tax and net, as well as capital repayments. It certifies your dividends.
coupons.document: One PDF per month, several years at once.
coupons.prerequisite: Cash account set up (initial state confirmed) and positions with a known ISIN.

points.certify: A dividend already recorded with the same amount receives the "Certified by statement" badge.
points.create: A coupon without a matching dividend creates the dividend, already certified; a pending proposal is accepted.
points.correct: A different amount offers a correction, unticked by default.
points.opening: Coupons before the initial state are kept without being credited; "Certify this amount" confirms dividends already received.
points.refunds: Capital repayments are created or certified, never counted as dividends.

coupons.tip: An unreadable statement or one whose total does not add up is rejected entirely: nothing is half-imported.

cash.title: Cash statements (PDF)
cash.intro: The monthly cash statement is authoritative for every money movement. It confirms the previous imports and fills in missing deposits: import it last.
cash.document: One PDF per month, up to 120 statements per batch.
cash.prerequisite: Cash account set up; trade confirmations and coupon statements imported if possible.

points.verify: Each buy, sell, dividend or deposit found to the cent receives the "Verified by cash statement" badge.
points.deposits: Deposits, withdrawals and fees missing from the app are created automatically.
points.coupons: A coupon without a recorded dividend creates the dividend, on the position you choose.
points.missing: A buy or sell without a trade is flagged "Missing trade confirmation": nothing is created.
points.continuity: A missing month or a balance break between two statements is flagged.

cash.tip: Opening balance + operations must equal the closing balance to the cent, otherwise the statement is rejected. A line matching several operations lets you choose.

control.title: Control and full history
control.intro: Once cash statements are imported, the "My PEA" page compares each month the statement balance with the balance computed by the app.

points.monthly: "Monthly account check": each month is matching, mismatched, without operations or to import.
points.gaps: For a mismatch, the likely causes and missing documents (trade confirmations, coupons) are listed.
points.fullHistory: If statements cover everything since opening, "Full history" replaces the initial state with the real transfers and dividends.

control.tip: After switching to full history, the annualised return can be computed. The check only reads: nothing is written.

icons.title: Asset icons
icons.empty: No asset in portfolio or watchlist.

dividends.title: Dividends
dividends.autoAcceptHelp: Off: every dividend paid on your holdings must be confirmed from the bell. On: certain dividends are recorded on their own, on their payment date, and reported in the bell.
dividends.autoAcceptDetails: A dividend is certain when the company's ISIN is known (imported trade notice or entered), its country is in the withholding tax table (excluding Irish and Luxembourg funds, often exempt), it is paid in euros and no nearby dividend was entered manually. Others still need confirming. Certain dividends already pending are recorded too.
dividends.autoAcceptCorrection: Every added dividend stays correctable (amount and date) from the bell or the "My PEA" page.
